title: Password Reset
content: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.
resolution: If the employee is locked out (5+ failed attempts), IT must manually unlock the account. For standard password resets, direct the employee to the self-service portal. No approval needed.
selfServeNote: Use the self-service portal for password resets. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, IT manual unlock is required.

title: VPN Access
content: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.
resolution: For expired credentials: employee must renew credentials themselves (90-day expiry cycle). For contractors: manager approval via access request form is required before IT can provision VPN access.
selfServeNote: VPN credentials expire every 90 days. Employees renew their own credentials. Contractors require manager approval via access request form.

title: Laptop Replacement
content: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.
resolution: Check laptop age and whether a hardware failure is verified. If laptop is 3+ years old, it qualifies for replacement subject to KB-03 and the Asset Management Policy. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance.

title: Software Installation
content: Standard software listed in the approved catalog can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review. Security review takes 3–5 business days.
resolution: If software is in the approved catalog: employee can self-install. If not in catalog (including browser extensions not in catalog): IT Security review required, taking 3–5 business days.

title: Printer Troubleshooting
content: For printer issues: 1. Check the printer queue. 2. Restart the print spooler. 3. If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.
resolution: Step 1: Check printer queue. Step 2: Restart print spooler. Step 3: If issue persists, escalate to IT with printer asset tag.
selfServeNote: Check printer queue, restart print spooler. If problem persists, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.

title: Email Mailbox Quota
content: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval. Maximum quota is 50GB.
resolution: Archive old email to free space. If a quota increase beyond 25GB is needed, manager approval is required. Maximum allowable quota is 50GB.
selfServeNote: Archive old email first. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval (max 50GB).

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
content: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours. Any employee can generate guest Wi-Fi credentials from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket is required.
resolution: No IT ticket required. Any employee can generate guest Wi-Fi credentials at the front-desk kiosk. Credentials are valid for 24 hours.
selfServeNote: Visit the front-desk kiosk to generate guest Wi-Fi credentials. They are valid for 24 hours. No IT ticket needed.

title: Expense Software Access
content: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account already exists.
resolution: Access provisioning is handled by Finance, not IT. If the employee already has an account but has a technical/login issue, IT can assist. Otherwise, route to Finance.

title: Security Incident Reporting
content: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately. The suspicious email should NOT be forwarded to other employees.
resolution: SECURITY INCIDENT: Escalate immediately to security@veridian-corp.example. Instruct the employee NOT to forward the suspicious email to anyone. Create a security ticket.

title: Work-From-Home Equipment
content: Employees working remotely more than 3 days/week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance. Eligible equipment includes chair and monitor. Requires: 1. Manager sign-off, 2. Finance processing. IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved.
resolution: Employee must get (1) Manager sign-off and (2) Finance approval first. IT handles the shipping request only after both approvals are in place.

title: Asset Management Policy
content: All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from the date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires: 1. Finance sign-off, 2. IT approval. Last updated Q2 2026. Issued by Finance & Assets.
resolution: Hardware replacement follows a 4-year cycle. Any early replacement requires Finance sign-off AND IT approval. When evaluating laptop replacement requests, consider both KB-03 and this policy.
